quizName:
DMV Practice Test  #15
										  					
  

30 Questions • Passing Score 21

questions.question: When should your wheels NOT be pointed straight ahead?

options.text: When waiting to turn left at a traffic light.
When parked on a hill or sloping driveway.
When parked on a level roadway with no curb.

questions.correctAnswerText: When parked on a hill or sloping driveway.
questions.explanation: When waiting to turn left, keep your wheels straight. If hit from behind, this stops you from moving into oncoming traffic. On hills, turn your wheels so your car will not roll into traffic if the brakes fail.

questions.question: You see a railroad crossing with a crossbuck sign but no gates or flashing lights. What should you do?

options.text: Approach with extreme caution and cross only when you know no train is coming.
Turn your radio down to listen for a train.
Continue only after a flagger clears you, if one is present.
All of the above.

questions.correctAnswerText: All of the above.
questions.explanation: Always approach railroad crossings with extreme caution. Cross only when you are sure no train is coming from either direction. If a flagger is present, obey their instructions.

questions.question: If your vehicle starts to skid, you should:

options.text: Turn the wheel too hard in the other direction.
Turn your steering wheel toward traffic.
Turn your steering wheel in the direction the car is skidding.
Let go of the steering wheel.

questions.correctAnswerText: Turn your steering wheel in the direction the car is skidding.
questions.explanation: If your vehicle skids, stay calm. Steer in the direction the car is skidding.

questions.question: The posted speed limit is the fastest you can legally drive in an area.

options.text: True
False

questions.correctAnswerText: True
questions.explanation: The posted speed limit is the fastest legal speed under ideal conditions. You must slow down when conditions require it, such as on slippery roads or when visibility is poor.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Slow down or stop.
Stop if necessary.
You must come to a complete stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must come to a complete stop.
questions.explanation: An octagonal sign always means stop. You must come to a complete stop at the marked stop line. Proceed only when it is safe. If there is no stop line, stop before the crosswalk. If there is no crosswalk, stop at a point where you can see oncoming traffic.

questions.question: If you need to slow down on a slippery road, what should you do first?

options.text: Press your brakes hard.
Take your foot off the gas pedal.
Use your parking brake.
Pump your brakes.

questions.correctAnswerText: Take your foot off the gas pedal.
questions.explanation: To slow down on a slippery road, first take your foot off the gas. If you need to slow more, gently press the brake pedal with steady, light pressure.

questions.question: When should you honk your horn?

options.text: When you are driving through an intersection.
When you are passing a cyclist.
When you see a child about to run into the street.
When you are parallel parking.

questions.correctAnswerText: When you see a child about to run into the street.
questions.explanation: Use your horn as a warning when another driver or pedestrian does not see you. For example, honk if a child starts to run into the street in front of your car.

questions.question: If you park in an unusual location, you should:

options.text: Park with your reverse lights on.
Make sure drivers can see your vehicle from any direction.
Park five feet from the curb.

questions.correctAnswerText: Make sure drivers can see your vehicle from any direction.
questions.explanation: When you park, make sure your car is visible to drivers approaching from all directions. This keeps your vehicle from becoming a hazard.

questions.question: What should you do when you see a flashing yellow light?

options.text: Stop before crossing the intersection.
Slow down and proceed carefully.
Wait for a green light before proceeding.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and proceed carefully.
questions.explanation: A flashing yellow light means slow down, check for traffic, and proceed with caution.

questions.question: What is your blind spot?

options.text: An area you cannot see without turning your head.
The area directly behind your vehicle.
The area you see in your rearview mirror.
The area you see in your side mirror.

questions.correctAnswerText: An area you cannot see without turning your head.
questions.explanation: Blind spots are areas you cannot see without turning your head. They are located to the sides and behind your vehicle.

questions.question: When changing lanes, what should you do?

options.text: Check your side mirror and look over your shoulder to make sure the lane is clear.
Check the rearview mirror.
Slow down.

questions.correctAnswerText: Check your side mirror and look over your shoulder to make sure the lane is clear.
questions.explanation: Before changing lanes, check your side mirrors and look over your shoulder to make sure it is safe.

questions.question: When turning left, you must yield the right-of-way to:

options.text: Other drivers already in the intersection.
Oncoming traffic.
Pedestrians already in the intersection.
All of the above.

questions.correctAnswerText: All of the above.
questions.explanation: When turning left, you must yield to oncoming traffic, pedestrians, bicyclists, and other drivers already in the intersection.

questions.question: Your brake lights tell other drivers that you:

options.text: Are making a turn.
Have your emergency brake on.
Are changing lanes.
Are slowing down or stopping.

questions.correctAnswerText: Are slowing down or stopping.
questions.explanation: Your brake lights tell other drivers you are slowing down or stopping. Keep your brake lights in good working order.

questions.question: Which factor affects how quickly a person absorbs alcohol?

options.text: Weight
Height
Intelligence

questions.correctAnswerText: Weight
questions.explanation: Weight, biological sex, how much food is in your stomach, and how many drinks you have had all affect alcohol absorption. The only way to remove alcohol from your body is to wait.

questions.question: A good rule for passing other vehicles is:

options.text: Pass on the right whenever possible.
Drive with the flow of traffic and pass only when needed.
Get to the front of slow traffic so you can see better.
Always flash your lights and use your horn to alert drivers.

questions.correctAnswerText: Drive with the flow of traffic and pass only when needed.
questions.explanation: Every time you pass, the risk of a collision increases. If you drive faster than traffic around you, you will have to keep passing. Drive with traffic flow within the speed limit and pass only when needed.

questions.question: If an aggressive driver cuts you off, you should:

options.text: Call the police immediately.
Stay calm and move out of their way.
Flash your lights to show they are wrong.
Do something aggressive back at them.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stay calm and move out of their way.
questions.explanation: If an aggressive driver cuts you off, stay calm and get out of their way. Trying to get even makes the situation more dangerous.

questions.question: Is it permitted to drive under the influence of medication that impairs your driving?

options.text: Never.
Yes, if you don't feel drowsy.
Yes, if a doctor prescribed it.

questions.correctAnswerText: Never.
questions.explanation: It is illegal to drive under the influence of any substance that impairs your driving. This includes alcohol, prescription drugs, over-the-counter drugs, and illegal drugs.

questions.question: To avoid becoming an aggressive driver, you should:

options.text: Relax and concentrate on driving.
Drive above the speed limit.
Tailgate the driver in front of you.

questions.correctAnswerText: Relax and concentrate on driving.
questions.explanation: Concentrate on driving and don't take other drivers' actions personally. Plan extra time, follow speed limits, and be patient with other drivers.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: Divided highway ends.
One-way traffic ahead.
Two-way traffic ahead.
Keep to the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Keep to the right.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you to keep to the right of the divider ahead.

questions.question: If a tire blows out while you are driving, what should you do?

options.text: Brake hard immediately.
Steer straight and slowly ease off the gas pedal.
Keep your speed and steer straight.
Swerve side to side to alert drivers behind you.

questions.correctAnswerText: Steer straight and slowly ease off the gas pedal.
questions.explanation: Hold the wheel tightly and keep the car straight. Ease off the gas pedal and don't brake until you have control. Then brake gently and pull off the road safely.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: No right turns.
Right turns are allowed.
Stop before turning right.
Sharp curve ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: No right turns.
questions.explanation: A red circle with a red slash means you cannot do that action. Right turns are not allowed where this sign is posted.

questions.question: An emergency vehicle with flashing lights is near you. What should you do?

options.text: Speed up to get out of the way.
Stop your vehicle and block their path.
Clear the path for the emergency vehicle to pass.
Signal to the emergency vehicle when it is safe to pass you.

questions.correctAnswerText: Clear the path for the emergency vehicle to pass.
questions.explanation: You must clear the path for emergency vehicles. Pull your vehicle to the side of the road if it is safe to do so.

questions.question: When must you always stop before crossing railroad tracks?

options.text: When there isn't enough space on the other side to completely cross the tracks.
When the crossing is in a town with frequent train traffic.
When you are carrying two or more young children.

questions.correctAnswerText: When there isn't enough space on the other side to completely cross the tracks.
questions.explanation: A train can come at any time on any track. Make sure your vehicle completely clears the tracks before you stop.

questions.question: You hit a parked car and the owner is not there. What must you do?

options.text: Call your insurance company when you get home.
Wait for the owner to come back.
Leave a note with your name and address on the car.

questions.correctAnswerText: Leave a note with your name and address on the car.
questions.explanation: You must leave a note with your name, phone number, and address attached to the vehicle you hit.

questions.question: Which of these increases the risk of a crash due to distraction?

options.text: CD player
Radio
Cell phone
All of the above

questions.correctAnswerText: All of the above
questions.explanation: Using a cell phone, radio, or CD player while driving can distract you and increase your crash risk.

questions.question: You have a green light but the intersection is blocked by traffic. What should you do?

options.text: Turn left and find another route.
Don't enter the intersection until traffic clears.
Follow other vehicles into the intersection.

questions.correctAnswerText: Don't enter the intersection until traffic clears.
questions.explanation: Even with a green light, do not enter the intersection if vehicles are blocking the way. If you get stuck in the intersection when the light turns red, you will block cross traffic and can get a ticket.

questions.question: When can you drive off the road to pass another vehicle?

options.text: If the vehicle ahead is turning left.
If there are two or more lanes in your direction.
Never.

questions.correctAnswerText: Never.
questions.explanation: You can never drive off the road or onto the shoulder to pass another vehicle.

questions.question: A flashing yellow light at a pedestrian crosswalk means:

options.text: Drivers may proceed with caution.
Drivers should slow down and be ready to stop.
Drivers should come to a complete stop.
There are no pedestrians nearby.

questions.correctAnswerText: Drivers should slow down and be ready to stop.
questions.explanation: A flashing yellow light at a pedestrian crossing means drivers should slow down and prepare to stop.

questions.question: Traffic moving in opposite directions is divided by ____ lines.

options.text: White
Red
Black
Yellow

questions.correctAnswerText: Yellow
questions.explanation: Yellow lines separate traffic moving in opposite directions.

questions.question: Crashes are more likely when:

options.text: All vehicles are traveling at the same speed.
One lane of traffic is faster than other lanes.
One vehicle is traveling faster or slower than the other traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: One vehicle is traveling faster or slower than the other traffic.
questions.explanation: Crashes happen more often when one driver goes faster or slower than other vehicles. Driving faster than traffic increases crash risk. Driving slower than traffic also causes crashes because other drivers may rear-end you or swerve to avoid you.
